deadline.value: September 2027 admission: international applicants by February 28, 2027 (domestic July 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field; McMaster Engineering does not require the GRE.

supervisor.value: All PhD students must have a supervisor; you need not find one yourself, as an offer is made when a faculty member is interested.
supervisor.quote: The MEng, MASc and PhD programs all require students to have a supervisor. | If a faculty member is interested then an offer of admission will be granted.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students receive department scholarship funding; Engineering's minimum is CAD 21,000 plus tuition.
funding.quote: Full time MASc and PhD students receive funding from the department in the form of scholarships.

also.quote: This minimum amount is $21,000 plus tuition

entry_route.value: A master's (MASc, MSc or equivalent) in a related field is required; bachelor's holders normally start in the MASc.
entry_route.quote: Master's Degree (MAsc, MSc, or equivalent) in a related field.

gre_general.value: The department neither requires nor accepts GRE results.
gre_general.quote: No, we do not require or accept GRE results.

toefl_min.value: The Faculty of Engineering requires TOEFL iBT 88 with at least 20 per band.
toefl_min.quote: Faculty of Engineering a minimum score of 88 (internet-based, iBT or iBT Home Edition); minimum of 20 per band.

english_waiver.value: A 4-year degree taught in English may be accepted as proof, with an official letter or transcript stating the language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: If you completed a 4 year degree in English, the department may accept this as proof of English language proficiency. You must include an official letter from your previous institution noting the language of instruction OR have this printed on your transcript.
